QuestInfo.name: Tale of the Ice Knight
QuestInfo.0: #bGordon#k of El Nath wants to tell you some old story...
QuestInfo.1: #bGordon#k tells you the origin of Ice Knight Battle Mode. He claims it's no fairy tale because #t1072510# are real. He promises to give #t1072510# to anyone who proves themselves.\n\n#rWin Ice Knight mode 10 or more times.#k

0.0: I've lived in this town for about 50 years now... Not as long as Alcaster, but I know plenty of myths and folktales nonetheless. For example... Did you know the story of Battle Mode's Ice Knight started in El Nath?
0.1: There once was a small kingdom deep in El Nath. Not wealthy, nor powerful, but very peaceful. But as in any good story, there are always those who abhor peace. In this story, it was the Kingdom's First Knight. He had a strong arm, and he enjoyed showing off.
0.2: The Knight left the kingdom in boredom. After many years, he returned, all of his strength gone. No one knows what happened to him, just that the once-arrogant warrior had suddenly become a coward... No one knows why.
0.3: The cowardly knight wanted to regain his power. He snuck into the castle dungeon and stole a suit of enchanted armor: Ice armor that granted mighty strength, but along with it came a fell curse.
0.4: With his new ice armor, he gained all the power and courage he desired, but all that was left of him was the need to destroy. He turned evil and eliminated many innocents. The King had to step in and defeat the Knight with his own hand. The ice armor was returned to the vault, and the Knight's name vanished into history...
0.5: Maybe it's true, maybe it isn't. But I think it's interesting. And I have some small evidence that it really happened: the #t01072510#. I'm no warrior, and have no need for armor. Do you want them?

yes.0: Hm... You can have them...if you win a little wager with me. I bet you can't #rwin 10 Ice Knight Battle Modes and become an Ice Knight#k! Prove me wrong, and they're all yours.

no.0: No? Huh. Well, that was a waste of time.

1.0: You won? Amazing! Okay, here's your #t01072510#, as promised.

yes.0: Huh? They look like normal snowshoes? It doesn't look like a legendary item? You don't think I'm just trying to push Battle Mode, do you? Hahaha... You know how items from old stories are.

default.0: #rWin 10 Ice Knight Battle Modes and become an Ice Knight#k! I know it's not easy...
